store.name: Kiln and Crema
store.tagline: Pieces from a feed of clay and coffee
store.about: Your feed lives between the café table and the studio bench. These pieces carry its warm cream and terracotta, with a little sea air at the edges.

products.title: Studio Disc Pendant
products.prompt: Pendant necklace in sterling silver: a 20 mm softly domed disc with an off-centre thumbprint hollow, like the base of a thrown cup, brushed matte finish, on an 18 in cable chain. No stones, no engraving, no text.
products.why: Your posts are set in a studio or workshop 33% of the time; this is a maker's mark in metal.

products.title: Tide Line Studs
products.prompt: Earrings in sterling silver: a pair of 12 mm studs, each a thin arc with a hammered texture like a wave line on wet sand, satin finish, butterfly backs. No stones, no text.
products.why: The coast shows up in 12% of your posts, a small but steady note.

products.title: Café Floor Rug
products.prompt: Printed area rug, 5x8 ft, low pile: a quiet grid of large terracotta and cream squares offset like an old café floor, each square at least 6 inches, with a thin espresso border. Flat printed pattern, no fringe, no text.
products.why: Cafés are the setting of 40% of your posts.

products.title: Linen Room Pillow
products.prompt: Printed throw pillow, 18x18 in: broad soft stripes of cream, sage and sea mist, like morning light across a bed, with one fine terracotta line. Flat print, hidden zip, no text.
products.why: Home interiors are 29% of your posts.

products.title: Glaze Study Print
products.prompt: Wall art print, 12x16 in, matte paper: an abstract study of three overlapping glaze pools in terracotta, sage and cream on a warm ground, soft edges, generous margins. No text, no signature.
products.why: Cafés frame 40% of your posts and studio work 33%; the print sits between them.

products.title: Cream Rim Plate
products.prompt: Decorative ceramic plate, 10 in, for display: a cream ground with a hand-drawn terracotta rim band and a small espresso dot pattern near the edge. No text.
products.why: Studio or workshop scenes are 33% of your posts.
